title: Khanjar tale
body:
Khanjar tale
(Ya Hussain) x4
<<MINI>>
(Khanjar talay, hussain hay, teero(n) ki jhari hai) x3
(Esi namaaz kisne) x2 Zamaane me parhi hai
(Khanjar talay, hussain hay, teero(n) ki jhari hai) x2
Wo hay hussain khoon say, jisnay wuzu kiya. Teero(n) ki ja-namaaz pay, al-hamd di sadaa (Sajday ko dekh maut bhi) x2 Hairan khari hai
Khanjar talay, hussain hay, teero(n) ki jhari hai
(Esi namaaz kisnay) x2 Zamaane me parhi hai
(Khanjar talay, hussain hay, teero(n) ki jhari hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Noke sina pe jisne, quran sunaya. Oor Oor ke garam rait nay, kafan uska banaaya (Halqay murida laash jo) x2 Maqtal me pari hai
<<MINI>>

Sinay me burchi haath me, hay laal ka jigar. Shabbir ka jigar he yay, shabbir ka pisar (Sinay may jiskay barchi) x2 Zalim nay gari hai
<<MINI>>

(Khanjar talay, hussain hay, teero(n) ki jhari hai) x2

Apnay hi garm khoon may, tarpay ali akbar. Thaa teer galay may rahay, hastay ali asghar (Yeh foj-e hussaini hi) x2 Karbal me lari hai
